phase12.formula: RNE(QK^T), source clamp/half-bit exp mapping, FP8(prob)*V / sum(half prob), E4M3 output
phase12.limitations: F32 tensorcore partial order/rcp and F16 accumulation may differ near quantization boundaries; not requiring bit equality to CPU.
